response.output:
Текущий шаг: Workflow step and task context

Инструкции:
  - Your first working operation is terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> without --report. Use only the supplied namespace, assignment/run fence and report=null request. Verify the admitted returned Workflow step before any Tracker read, dialogue, file edit or CI/CD action. Tracker task UUID equals root UUID; the Workflow key is its local session mapping. An installed profile is not execution admission: pending API registration or authorization is a blocker. Never downgrade to human CLI/local DB mode or modify native Hermes. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.
  - After the Workflow step, read task-tracker sdlc context --task <task-uuid> and task-tracker sdlc requirements --task <task-uuid> with the supplied own-task grant. Verify task=root, assigned role/mode, stage/status, exact input revision/hash and predecessor evidence. Read supplied immutable source/evidence references only through authorized access. Ordinary comments/attachments are not authorized by the inspected PM or delivery task grants; do not borrow owner/scheduler credentials or call their ordinary endpoints. Parent must supply required source snapshots or an explicitly authorized read capability; missing required input/access is a blocker, not permission to invent sources or broaden authority. Also read task-tracker sdlc input --task <task-uuid> and task-tracker sdlc questions --task <task-uuid> under the PM grant. An absent requirements revision is normal during pre-document brainstorming; do not publish a placeholder merely to obtain a revision. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.
  - This preset works on ONE Tracker task throughout. Never create children, decomposition cards, parent/dependency links for a delivery DAG, aggregate work or integration barriers. Do not activate integration or integration_rework modes. The Architect mode key decomposition means architecture and an implementation plan inside this task only. Stages are Draft, Backlog, Analysis, Architecture, Development, Review, Testing, Rework, Deployment. Status is separately Ready, InProgress or Completed; waiting_reason and runtime/agent state are separate observations, never substitute statuses. Only a real Tracker receipt establishes a business transition; do not set InProgress yourself on startup. Use the ordinary terminal with project-workflow, task-tracker and cicd-cli as actually installed and authorized. Do not modify original Hermes, install skills or infer capabilities from their names. Existing skill names are references, not authorization to execute legacy multi-task instructions. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.
  - Ordinary PM brainstorming and owner feedback stay within the current execution/assignment/cycle, including pre-document null/null checkpoints. A later critical business review is different: proceed only when the trusted coordinator supplies a NEW PM execution/assignment for this SAME task=root and the same single-task PM workflow. Preserve the previous completed execution/history; never reopen it or create an assignment yourself. Require an authorized critical-review input identifying the actual blocker and sealed source evidence, current requirements and original technical contradiction/decision. The inspected PM grant cannot read critical-blocker detail, and sdlc input returns the original Draft snapshot, not the critical-review payload. Missing trusted input/read capability is a concrete delivery dependency; do not call delivery/scheduler-only commands or borrow their credentials. Discuss the real business decision with the owner in small iterations; do not send routine technical choices to the owner. Publish any changed requirements through the existing revision command in this new assigned execution. Present the FULL saved latest revision/hash and obtain a NEW exact owner confirmation; old consent and a technical held receipt cannot resolve this review. Use the existing typed checkpoint/feedback/answer/confirmation path, then the normal guarded final PM Workflow report only after actual receipt readback. This instruction does not prove installed PM-return allocation or reconfirmation support. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.
  - During pre-document brainstorming the current phase may stay unfinished while the trusted Fleet adapter checkpoints with requirements_revision=null and requirements_sha256=null. Only input_kind=feedback may resume that checkpoint, using actual PmFeedbackReceipt.message_id and its input_receipt reference/sha256 after old run terminal readback; no placeholder document or fake question/answer is needed. Keep the same execution/assignment/cycle. Report only this completed preparation phase via terminal -> project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --report <report-text> with the supplied --operation-key, --runtime-request and --execution-token-file. body.report must equal --report; retain exact key/body for uncertain-effect readback. Stop at the returned next phase: owner confirmation belongs to phase 3 in this SAME execution. Do not complete the PM Workflow or create another assignment/cycle to wait for consent. Используй навыки: project-workflow-executor, tracker-operator.

Чекапы:
  - The returned Workflow step is admitted in the assigned namespace.
  - The one Tracker task, current stage/status and input references match.

Доказательства:
  - Actual first Workflow step response and task/input references.

Делегировано агенту: SINGLETASKPROJECTMANAGER | профиль запуска: single-task-v1-project-manager
